title: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal World Modeling with Content-Adaptive Spatial Addressing
abstract: arXiv:2611.25610v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon world modeling in partially observable environments requires compact memories that preserve spatial structure despite accumulated localization drift. Inspired by hippocampal episodic and spatial memory and the multi-periodic coding of entorhinal grid cells, we propose HiSTFormer, a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model, which adopts a layer-wise organization of local temporal RoPE and multi-periodic spatial RoPE, together with content-conditioned address offsets, to capture recent temporal context and long-range spatial structure. A fixed-capacity memory keeps KV storage and per-step attention cost bounded as the sequence grows. On MemoryMaze and HM3D, HiSTFormer outperforms strong world-model baselines within the training sequence length and generalizes substantially better to prediction horizons far beyond those seen during training, while using a compact model. The hierarchical spatiotemporal design remains effective

translated_title: 基于内容自适应空间寻址的分层时空世界建模
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测环境中的长时程世界建模需要紧凑的记忆机制，使其在定位漂移不断累积的情况下仍能保持空间结构。受海马体情景与空间记忆以及内嗅皮层网格细胞多周期编码的启发，我们提出了HiSTFormer——一种分层时空世界模型。该模型采用逐层组织的局部时间RoPE与多周期空间RoPE，并结合内容条件化的地址偏移，以捕获近期时间上下文和长程空间结构。固定容量的记忆使KV存储和每步注意力成本在序列增长时保持有界。在MemoryMaze和HM3D上，HiSTFormer在训练序列长度内优于强世界模型基线，并对远超训练所见预测时域的任务表现出显著更好的泛化能力，同时模型规模紧凑。该分层时空设计保持有效。
tldr: 提出受海马体记忆与网格细胞启发的分层时空世界模型HiSTFormer，通过局部时间RoPE、多周期空间RoPE和内容自适应寻址，实现有界紧凑记忆，并在MemoryMaze和HM3D上取得优异的长时程预测性能与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: HiSTFormer, a hippocampus-inspired hierarchical spatiotemporal world model combining local temporal RoPE, multi-periodic spatial RoPE, and content-adaptive addressing, achieves bounded compact memory with superior long-horizon prediction and generalization on MemoryMaze and HM3D.
